description: This file defines functions to load environment-specific include patterns and to create a Vitest configuration for channels, exporting a default configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from environment variable 'OPENCLAW_VITEST_INCLUDE_FILE' or defaults to process.env.

methods.name: export function createChannelsVitestConfig(env?: Record<string, string | undefined>) { createChannelsVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a Vitest configuration scoped for channel tests with specified include patterns and settings.
